text:
chris_k: Heads up — GCP ap-south H100 on-demand rates jumped ~38% overnight. Our reserved pools there still cover baseline but burst costs spiked. Need a quick packaging + margin scrub. :eyes:

alex_chan: Seen it. Dashboard + raw billing here: https://docs.internal/reports/ap-south-gpu-billing (perm: finance). Looks like burst % of total token cost went from 6% -> 18% in 48h.

finance_ops: If burst stays elevated we wipe margin on Dedicated APAC customers unless we act. Options: regional surcharge, absorb for Q, or re-route traffic + rebalance reserves.

maria_ng: Quick note — our ReservedCommit contract with cloud has a 60d rebalancing window. We can shift future reservations but not instant. For immediate relief we can throttle non-critical background workloads and push batch reruns to other regions.

chris_k: Agree. Two quick tactical asks: 1) calc P&L impact if we absorb for next 30 days, 2) estimate engineering lift to shift 20% of ap-south bursts to us-east as fallback.

alex_chan: Putting numbers in sheet now. Preliminary calc: current daily burst spend ap-south = $18k/day. If absorb for 30d -> $540k hit. If we add a 5% regional surcharge on Hosted API traffic in APAC would cover ~60% of that delta (rough back-of-envelope).

finance_ops: Can you paste the actual formula? need to show to execs.

alex_chan: Sure — tiny snippet I used:

```
# single-region burst cost estimate
daily_burst_cost = burst_hours_per_day * avg_instance_price_per_hour * active_instances
monthly_delta = daily_burst_cost * 30
```

maria_ng: On the routing side — devs have a 3-day window to add region-aware fallback in runtime. Impact: ~10% latency regression for some endpoints; should be fine for non-SLA routes.

sre-bot: [alert] ap-south cluster preemptions up 2.3x, evictions affecting batch jobs. Link: https://ops.internal/alerts/9876

lisa_pm: For product: we must protect enterprise customers. Recommendation: 1) Enable routing fallback for PLG/non-enterprise traffic within 48h, 2) Queue a 30d absorb with monthly review, 3) Finance to model a small APAC surcharge for new Dedicated signups. I'll draft comms for CSMs.

chris_k: Proposed immediate plan: (A) throttle background batch + shift replays to us-east (eng lift: 3 devs, 72h), (B) finance to model absorb vs 3% surcharge scenarios, (C) lock enterprise billing to current rates and escalate to sales to discuss pass-through for new contracts.

finance_ops: I'll run the three scenarios and post the sheet by EOD. Alex/Maria — can you add the engineering estimates to the doc?

alex_chan: On it. Adding estimated latency/ops risk and a short runbook for region-failover.

maria_ng: I'll schedule a quick sync with infra + platform in 2 hours. Invite: @chris_k @alex_chan @finance_ops.

chris_k: Thanks — let's aim for an exec note by tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
